description: This file contains CMake macro and function definitions related to string encoding using ASCII codes, specifically defining a macro 'string_codes' that assigns ASCII character codes to variables and a function 'string_codes_print' that prints these variables.

methods.name: string_codes
methods.description: Defines a macro that sets variables with ASCII code values based on input arguments.

methods.name: string_codes_print
methods.description: Defines a function that calls 'string_codes' and then prints various string-related variables.
